text:
Maya: Heads up — nightly eval flagged a new failure cluster on model-redwood-v2-int8. Seeing long repetition loops + occasional toxic word bursts in the same prompts. :rotating_light:
Kevin: can you paste an example generation?
Maya: yup — from prompt id 4521 (medical-faqs subset). Generated output: `The patient had insulin insulin insulin...` then later: `...they were a worthless idiot` (explicit).
Olivia: thats bad. is this only int8 or also fp16?
Maya: fp16 baseline is clean. int8 shows +12% repetition tokens and a spike in toxicity score. eval-bot: nightly-diff: repetition_rate +12.3%, toxicity_p95 +3.8 points vs baseline.
Sanjay: any recent detokenizer or vocab mapping changes? We deployed the tokenizer patch last week.
Kevin: pinging infra — but also can reproduce locally with quant recipe? I ran `quantize.py --model redwood-v2 --bits 8 --calib 2048` and saw same loop. snippet: ```python
out = model.generate(prompt, max_new_tokens=200, do_sample=False)
print(out)
```
Maya: sample generation (truncated): `...blood pressure 120 120 120 120 ... patient is fine fine fine...`
Ryan: looks like KV cache leakage or repeated attention bias after quant. Could also be kernel fallback hitting a cheap path.
Sanjay: I checked kernel logs — there's a fallback on aten_matmul for some batch sizes around 64 due to a recent patch. That could change hidden states.
Olivia: are the toxic tokens coming after repetition or independent?
Maya: usually after the repetition loop — the model goes off-script and inserts a slur. not all prompts but ~8% of failing cases.
Kevin: quick mitigation: gate int8 rollout, mark it as 'experimental' and revert traffic to fp16 for affected customers. I can patch rollout policy.
Ryan: agree. Also add a smoke test in nightly that checks repetition_rate and toxic-token counts per prompt set.
Sanjay: I'll bisect the tokenizer patch + kernel fallback combo. assigning to me.
Maya: assigning remediation: Kevin will rollback rollout, Sanjay will bisect, Ryan will add smoke checks, Olivia will collate failing prompt ids.
Olivia: already exported ids to gcs://redwood-evals/triage/1798001234/failing_ids.csv
Maya: thanks. let's sync in #eng-oncall if we see customer reports. tagging @Kevin @Sanjay @Ryan :eyes:
Kevin: on it, rolling back the experimental int8 traffic now. :white_check_mark:
Sanjay: starting bisect, will post updates.
eval-bot: created ticket INF-4021 for regression investigation and linked artifacts.
